title: HOW DOES SMP TREATMENT LOOK – STEP BY STEP

hero.heading: HOW DOES SMP TREATMENT LOOK – STEP BY STEP
hero.subtitle: Scalp micropigmentation is not just a treatment – it is a process that delivers real, visible results through carefully planned steps. Each session has its purpose, and together they create an effect that looks completely natural.

sections.title: CONSULTATIONS – IN PERSON OR ONLINE
bullets: Detailed analysis of the scalp and skin type
Discussion about your wishes and expectations
Proposal for the shape of the frontal hairline
Number of sessions and density assessment
text: Consultations are conducted in the studio or via WhatsApp/Viber video calls.

sections.title: FIRST SESSION – BASE LAYER
text: This session lays the foundation – the first effect of the SMP treatment can be seen here.
bullets: The agreed hairline is drawn
Base layer pigmentation begins
Coverage of main areas (crown, temples, nape) is defined
Performed 10–20 days after the first session
Pigment from the first session has stabilized
Density is increased, creating a transition between areas
A realistic 'hair' look begins to form

sections.title: THIRD SESSION – FINISH AND BALANCE
bullets: Final processing of all areas
Detail refinement and possible frontal line corrections
Final control of density and uniformity
text: If necessary, a fourth session can be scheduled at no additional cost.

sections.title: WHAT IS ALLOWED AND WHAT IS NOT AFTER THE TREATMENT
bullets: Dry healing for the first 24 hours – do not wet the treated area
Use healing balm
Dry the treated area with a clean paper tissue, without rubbing
If itching – gently tap, do not scratch
Wear a cap or hat outdoors
Once healed – use sunscreen (SPF) to protect the pigment
Keep hair short for optimal visual effect
Avoid excessive sweating in the first 24 hours
Do not wash hair for the first 3 days
Do not use clippers for 3 days
Do not shave the head for 5 days
Do not use styling products (gel, wax, etc.) for 7 days
Pause Minoxidil use if applicable – 7 days
Do not swim in the sea or pool for 14 days
Avoid sauna and solarium for one month
text: What to do after the treatment:

Following these guidelines significantly contributes to proper healing and the long-lasting SMP effect.

faqs.title: MOST FREQUENT QUESTIONS ABOUT THE SMP PROCESS

list.q: How long does one session last?
list.a: Usually lasts between 2 and 4 hours, depending on the size of the area.

list.q: Can I go to work after the treatment?
list.a: Yes – most clients resume their daily activities the next day.
